_doc: Provenance index for every file under frontend/assets/. Each rule matches files by glob (repo-relative); every file must match exactly one rule. kind: generated = rebuilt by `recipe`; attested = owner-supplied, no recipe possible (see `why`); third-party = licensed from someone else and must be listed in `third_party_allowlist`. Checked by tools/assets/tests/asset_manifest_test.py. See docs/ASSETS.md.
